# Requirements — orders

| Id | Requirement |
|---|---|
| REQ-001 | an order needs at least one line |
| REQ-002 | a second order with the same reference is refused |
| REQ-003 | the order total is the sum of its lines |
| REQ-004 | a cancelled order cannot be shipped |
| REQ-005 | a closed order keeps no history attached |
| REQ-006 | five failed sign-ins lock the account |
